name: Sentora 2027
description: Web hosting control panel: websites, domains, mail (Postfix, Dovecot, Roundcube, SOGo), FTP, MariaDB, phpMyAdmin and Let's Encrypt for many client accounts.

fields.label: Panel address (a DNS name pointing at this NAS, e.g. panel.example.com)

notes: First start installs Sentora inside the container (5-30 minutes; follow Container Manager → Containers → sentora → Log until 'Sentora is installed'). Passwords: sudo docker exec sentora cat /root/passwords.txt. Websites, mail and databases live inside the container: update it with sudo docker exec -it sentora sentora-update, and never use Update/Rebuild for this project in Container Manager. Needs ports 80 and 443, so Web Station can't run at the same time.
compose:
services:
  sentora:
    image: ghcr.io/rustus/sentora2027:latest
    container_name: sentora
    hostname: ${F:hostname}
    restart: unless-stopped
    pull_policy: missing
    cgroup: private
    security_opt:
      - writable-cgroups=true
    tmpfs:
      - /run
      - /run/lock
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN
    environment:
      - SENTORA_EMAIL=${F:email}
      - TZ=${TZ}
    volumes:
      - ./backup:/backup
    ports:
      - "80:80"
      - "443:443"
      - "21:21"
      - "61000-61099:61000-61099"
      - "25:25"
      - "465:465"
      - "587:587"
      - "110:110"
      - "143:143"
      - "993:993"
      - "995:995"
      - "4190:4190"
